title: Specify rational local thermal dynamics and expose the paid-completion stationarity boundary
statement: For a bounded-degree commuting-Pauli Hamiltonian H=-sum S_a, local syndrome projectors Pi_{v,P,s} and Delta E=2sum s_a give jumps J=sqrt(min(1,2^-h Delta E))*P_v Pi at fixed integer h. Delta E is even, hence jump coefficients are rational powers of two; support, norm and term count per qubit are constant, with beta=h log2 Gibbs stationarity from detailed balance. Actual added support depolarization gamma(T_X-id) permits E_X completion to arbitrary CPTP Poisson payloads if gamma>=dstar^2 epsilon0. This changes the device and generally breaks Gibbs stationarity even when E=0. A thermal lifetime estimate cannot be reused for that driven generator without a new robust confinement proof.
